about_the_game:
• About This Module
    This DLC module is a community-created work. We only provided technical supervision.
    All DLC content was created by the author (a player). To encourage more community creators to experiment with expanding game content, we promised the author we would not modify the storyline as long as it complies with public order and moral standards.

For this module, we will only address technical issues and optimize certain art assets.
If you encounter unsatisfactory aspects during gameplay (such as specific scenes, characters, or combat experiences), please provide feedback. We'll relay it to the author and make every effort to fix these shortcomings where possible.

  • Module Content Features Linear Storytelling
    The module focuses on linear storytelling without multiple distinct endings or side plots.
    Note: While there are six endings, they don't differ significantly in their overall direction. It's worth mentioning that the longest narrative segment in the module doesn't lead to its "best" ending.

    Players who care about this aspect should consider carefully before purchasing.

  • Contains Bloody, Horror, and Disturbing Content
    Some game sequences contain violent and gory elements. Players with low psychological tolerance should exercise discretion when purchasing.

At the beginning of the story, an "old friend" of yours, Sheriff Triss, suddenly calls you and asks you to go to a local exhibition hall to assist in the investigation of a heinous murder case...

As we all know, in dreams, everything becomes beautiful, and so does <Die Traumdeutung>.

In this story, you will play a detective who has obtained the power of time and space, travel back to the past of the crime scene, easily solve the unsolvable cases, and bring the real culprits to justice one by one; just like Fu Ermosi and Hua Sheng, Poirot and Hastings, in the story, there is also a doctor lady standing beside you who will always support you. At this moment, an ancient one that has been eyeing the town covetously will also emerge from the depths. Detective, hold your sidearm tightly, repel them, and write the legend of a detective.

Meanwhile, as someone who wields the power of time and space, you will also reap an old sentiment, strolling in the garden where violets bloom; on a night when fireflies flutter, you will kiss the back of her slender hand goodbye; in a cold and icy room, you will embrace her.

The story is full of love and peace.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game does not depict explicit sexual acts or sexual violence, but contains the following adult content:
Violent depictions: Includes detailed descriptions of murder scenes, blood-stained environments, the use of deadly weapons (such as scalpels and glass shards), and graphic portrayals of injuries and bleeding.
Psychological themes and mental distress: Covers topics such as dissociative identity disorder, personality deconstruction, dreams, and the subconscious. These elements may evoke unease or psychological discomfort.
Gore and blood: Numerous scenes involve vivid bloodstains, bodily trauma, and graphic depictions of severe accidents.
Potentially disturbing scenarios: Includes mental breakdowns, near-death experiences, intense emotional shocks, and moments resembling terminal lucidity.

short_description: This mod is included in the crowd-sourced collaborative expansion pack of "Depersonalization". This mod was originally created by the mod author Xifeng, independently completed using the in-game editor, authorized by MeowNature, and underwent resource supplementation/reset and program optimization.
